summary: GTM (ZoomInfo) presents as honestly-disclosed SaaS in a credit-cyclical downcycle — clean going-concern, clean auditor tenure, real H-1B-backed headcount, continuously re-disclosed securities litigation, and routine 10b5-1 insider sales.
